title: 第9章 江家武技阁第10章 拔刀斩
slug: 无限吞噬你们求我晋级慢一点
content_zh:
“娘，这些东西是专门给你的。”
江尘笑道。
“尘儿，你哪儿来的这么多灵石购买蕴灵丹？”
李慧容问道。
“娘，这些都是我赚的，这五阶红阳果是我从大荒山脉之中采来的。”
江尘道。
“什么？你前几天去大荒山脉了？”
李慧容吃了一惊。
江尘虽然说还能修炼，但是毕竟境界还弱，进入大荒山脉，那是跟找死没有什么区别。
那儿不但有强大的妖兽，还有一些修炼者会进入，在大荒山脉之中，杀人夺宝的事情经常发生，太危险了。
在青月镇中还好一点，人多，很少会有乱来。
“尘儿，以后不要去大荒山脉了，知道吗？如果你再有什么事，我与你爹怎么办？”
李慧容担心地道。
江尘内心一暖，他知道母亲是在担心他，这个世界就是这样，以武为尊，弱肉强食。
江尘进入大荒山脉也是想变得更强大，这样的话就可以掌控自己的命运，保护身边重要的人了。
“娘，你放心吧，我没有事，现在我的修为已经恢复了。”
江尘说完，将自己的修为散发出来，武者境四重。
“你居然是武者境四重修为了？”
李慧容吃了一惊。
她是武者境九重的修炼者，现在江尘将气息散发出来她可以清晰地感应到江尘的具体修为。

怎么才几天的时间不见，江尘的实力暴涨了这么多？
“没错，我已经是武者境四重了，所以就算入大荒山脉，我也有一定的自保之力，我也不会深入太多，我也是得到机缘，我的实力才恢复得这么快的。”
江尘道。
“原来如此，你的实力在这么短的时间达到这个境界，你的机缘应该不少，那么我也就不过问了。”
李慧容欣慰地道。
自己的儿子强大了，身为母亲的她当然高兴。
“所以，娘亲，这三枚蕴含丹你服用吧，争取早点迈入武师境，我有修炼资源。”
江尘道。
“好，我们的尘儿长大了。”
李慧容点点头，收下江尘给的东西。
一直以来，他们一家的资源不多，想要修炼，让修为变得更加强大，除了本身的天赋之外，还需要更加多的资源。
为什么那么多人都想加入大势力？
那是因为，加入大势力中，有机会获得更加多的资源。
为什么那么多大势力会出现这么多强者？
大势力的年轻一辈的天赋不一定比小势力的天才强，但是修为会强大这么多。
很大的原因是因为大势力可以提供大量的资源培养弟子。
资源就是实力。
想要变得强大，那么就必须获得更多的资源。
出身低的人，就算天赋再强大，没有足够的资源，没有条件，天赋也很容易埋没。
“娘，我需要前往武技阁一趟，你做好饭等我回来。”

江尘道。
“好。”
content_en:
"Mom, these things are specially for you."
Jiang Chen smiled.
"Chen'er, where did you get so many spiritual stones to buy the Spirit-Absorbing Pill?"
Li Huirong asked.
"Mom, I earned all of this. I picked these fifth-level red sun fruits from the Great Wilderness Mountains."
Jiang Chen said.
"What? Did you go to the Great Wilderness Mountains a few days ago?"
Li Huirong was surprised.
Although Jiang Chen said he could still cultivate, his state was still weak after all. Entering the Great Wilderness Mountains was no different from seeking death.
Not only are there powerful monsters there, but also some cultivators will enter. In the wilderness mountains, murders and treasure grabbing often occur, which is too dangerous.
It's a little better in Qingyue Town. There are many people and there is little chaos.
"Chen'er, don't go to the Great Wilderness Mountains anymore, you know? If something happens to you again, what will your father and I do?"
Li Huirong was worried.
Jiang Chen felt warm in his heart. He knew that his mother was worried about him. The world was like this, where force was respected and the weak was the strongest.
Jiang Chen also wanted to become stronger when he entered the Great Wilderness Mountains, so that he could control his own destiny and protect the important people around him.
"Mom, don't worry, I'm fine. My cultivation has recovered now."
After Jiang Chen finished speaking, he radiated his cultivation to the fourth level of the warrior realm.
"Are you actually at the fourth level of the warrior realm?"
Li Huirong was surprised.
She is a practitioner at the ninth level of the warrior realm, and now that Jiang Chen is emitting his aura, she can clearly sense Jiang Chen's specific cultivation level.
Why did Jiang Chen's strength surge so much after not seeing each other for just a few days?
"That's right, I'm already at the fourth level of the warrior realm, so even if I enter the Great Wilderness Mountains, I still have a certain ability to protect myself. I won't go too deep. I also got the opportunity and my strength recovered so quickly."
Jiang Chen said.
"I see, your strength has reached this level in such a short period of time, so you should have a lot of opportunities, so I won't bother."
Li Huirong said happily.
As a mother, she is of course happy that her son has become stronger.
"So, mother, take these three containing pills and strive to enter the martial arts realm as soon as possible. I have the training resources."
Jiang Chen said.
"Okay, our Chen'er has grown up."
Li Huirong nodded and accepted what Jiang Chen gave her.
For a long time, their family did not have many resources. If they wanted to practice and make their cultivation stronger, in addition to their own talents, they also needed more resources.
Why do so many people want to join a big force?
That's because if you join a big force, you have the opportunity to obtain more resources.
Why do so many powerful people appear in so many big forces?
The talents of the younger generation of the big forces may not be stronger than the geniuses of the small forces, but their cultivation will be so much stronger.
The big reason is that big forces can provide a lot of resources to cultivate disciples.
Resources are strength.
If you want to become stronger, you must obtain more resources.
For people of low origin, no matter how powerful their talents are, if they don't have enough resources or conditions, their talents will be easily buried.
"Mom, I need to go to the Martial Arts Pavilion. Please prepare a meal and wait for me to come back."
Jiang Chen said.
"good."
